Merriam-Webster’s Learner’s Dictionary

bow 4
  • US [ˈboʊ]
  • GB
  • 1 .

    NOUN a knot that is made by tying a ribbon or string into two or more loops and that is used for tying shoelaces or for decoration see also BOW TIE

  • 2 .

    NOUN a weapon used for shooting arrows that is made of a long , thin piece of wood which is bent with its ends connected by a tight , strong string

  • 3 .

    NOUN a tool that is used for playing a violin or similar musical instrument and that is made of a thin stick of wood with its ends connected by stretched pieces of hair or fiber see picture at STRINGED INSTRUMENT
